decisions.finding: The scalar G1 claim is validated only at its final value. intermediate_truthful=true is self-reported, not an approved series. Historical interpolation has no source-backed intermediate values.
decisions.safe_implementation: RENDER_NUMBER_SERIES_UNVERIFIED typed fail-closed for unsupported historical values; do not promote exact-value reveal to number-count semantic PASS.
decisions.minimum_owner_change: G1 historical-source owner must authorize an immutable ordered numeric series or explicitly nonfactual counter semantics, including intermediate interpretation, units, precision, source claim IDs and reviewed evidence. B2 may then bind/revalidate exact values without changing G2/G3.

decisions.finding: Existing outgoing transition_intent=mask_reveal and chronological adjacency can authorize a uniquely defined next scene only when the incoming mask-transition event begins at local frame 0 and duration is within both scenes. Otherwise prior transition_out.duration_frames=0 is insufficient.
decisions.safe_implementation: Compute bounded overlap from the eligible frozen pair. Shared Player/Node Composition renders previous frozen scene and incoming screen-space native mask in actual incoming window. Unpaired generic reveals are not two-surface semantic PASS.
decisions.minimum_owner_change: If a desired transition lacks this uniquely authored boundary, require G1 storyboard source to specify the intended two scene identities and chronological window. Do not derive from z-order.

decisions.finding: asset_approval_heads has one current approval_id per (project_id,requirement_id). Old asset_approval_events are historical records, not concurrently approved alternatives. No current authorized choice set exists in the published model.
decisions.safe_implementation: Reject changed approved_asset_id at G4; preserve original byte SHA, requirement/rights and G3 snapshot; no fabricated approval.
decisions.minimum_owner_change: G3 asset owner must separately approve a same-requirement, same-slot candidate choice set with per-candidate rights/source SHA and immutable snapshot identity; B2 G4 can then select among that explicitly current set using CAS.

decisions.finding: G2 WordTimingMap holds exact word IDs/text/time, but G1 on-screen text is an independently authored string and supplies no general word-to-glyph identity mapping.
decisions.safe_implementation: Add optional B2 layer.word_spans derived only where unchanged G2 token text matches exactly one unchanged G1 visible token; verify offset/text identities in renderer and transform/highlight only that span. Ambiguous/repeated/unmatched words block deterministically.
decisions.minimum_owner_change: For repeated or visually paraphrased words, require an explicitly owner-reviewed G1/B2 visual span binding to unchanged G2 word IDs. Never infer which repeated token was spoken.
